h1: Shop Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 50 m²

blocks.text: Shop Interior Design & Custom Furniture, 50 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) developed the interior design project for a 50 m² shop, including the design and production of custom furniture created specifically for the retail space.

Particular attention was given to the functional organization of the compact floor area, customer and staff comfort, product presentation and the overall visual identity of the shop. The layout solutions make efficient use of the available space while providing convenient circulation for visitors.

The project included custom retail furniture designed as an integral part of the interior concept. Tailor-made solutions make it possible to consider the dimensions of the premises, product display and storage requirements, everyday functionality and the company’s visual identity.
The page features photorealistic 3D visualizations of the design project, providing a detailed view of the proposed layout, retail environment and custom furniture solutions before implementation.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides shop, boutique, showroom and commercial interior design, as well as custom furniture design and production in Bratislava and Vienna. We develop individual interior solutions for retail spaces, showrooms, offices, beauty salons and other commercial environments.
